metadata.name: darwin-skill
metadata.description: Darwin Skill 2.0 (达尔文.skill 2.0): autonomous skill optimizer, v2.0 integrates Microsoft Research SkillLens (arXiv 2605.23899) 9-dim rubric + SkillOpt (arXiv 2605.23904) validation-gated design + human-in-the-loop checkpoints. Evaluates SKILL.md files using a 9-dimension rubric (structure + effectiveness + meta-skill blacklists), runs hill-climbing with git version control, spawns independent judge agents for blind evaluation, validates improvements through test prompts with auto-break on diminishing returns, and generates visual result cards. Use when user mentions "优化skill", "skill评分", "自动优化", "auto optimize", "skill质量检查", "达尔文", "darwin", "帮我改改skill", "skill怎么样", "提升skill质量", "skill review", "skill打分".

metadata.name: skill-update-guard
metadata.description: Use when 需要检查本机从 GitHub 克隆的 skill 有没有新版本、准备把某个 skill 更新到上游、或要判断某次 skill 更新是否安全可应用。触发词：检查skill更新、更新skill、skill落后了吗、skill是不是最新、升级skill、skill outdated、skill update、这个skill更新安全吗、更新完校验。也适用于目录带 .git 的 skill、或更新后 manifest 指纹需要重新对齐的场景。不用于花叔系复制安装的 skill（走 huashu-skill-updater），也不用于改写 SKILL.md 正文（走 darwin-skill）。
